text: Related: intake-contract epic bd-01M2R747J0SCHRFH9BF70TWT4S. Same defect class, found again in three review passes over a new subsystem: a carrier whose STATUS is publicly constructible. Scala 3 enum cases are case classes, so 'enum Coded { case Known(raw) }' lets a consumer assert a decode that never happened. Bead bd-01M2R75R20PGYBW98MQ9X8T5M1 closes it with sealed trait + final non-case classes + private[corpus] ctor, probed from package storymodel4s.consumer -- a probe INSIDE the package cannot tell a closed door from an open one. Two further sites of the same shape are flagged for cold review in bd-01M2R7SFVNFBSD83DV22EVM8H6.
